scope: Corollary 1.2 (Bloch’s conjecture for surfaces with pg = 0) of the manuscript “Bloch’s conjecture for surfaces with p_g=0” (preprints/Blochs-Conjecture-for-Surfaces-with-pg-equals-q-equals-0-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 040 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 afb7bf56f8d97111), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let S be a smooth connected projective surface over C with pg(S) = 0. Then the Albanese homomorphism albS : CH0(S)0 −→ Alb(S)(C) is an isomorphism of abelian groups, where CH0(S) has integral coefficients.
